subject: general
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

None than you deserve credit for the success of this project.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'None than you' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be 'None other than you'.
 
 
• The manager of this company is **none other than** the owner's son.
 
 

Hence, the correct sentence should read: ***None other than you deserve credit for the success of this project***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is important to use the correct phrases to convey the intended meaning accurately.
 
• Using the phrase 'None other than' emphasizes that **no one else but the mentioned person deserves the credit.**
